item.text: {"verdict":"revise","issues":[{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:brief-a-freya-bank-early.p2","brief-a:brief-a-freya-bank-early.p1"],"location":"verified_account: get_account post_process_code and task_message; terminal outcomes","message":"On get_account failure or a positive response without one unambiguous product, the workflow directs service_error, but it has no defined path to resolve the call. More fundamentally, the prompt says one product while the API returns a products array; selecting one or closing without following the applicable outcome can leave the conversation without a valid source-defined disposition. The provided sources do not define an account-lookup failure outcome, so treating this as service_error is an invented policy.","fix":"Do not invent service_error for get_account failure. Add a source-grounded handling rule or flag the ambiguous case for policy resolution before assigning an outcome."},{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:6","brief-a:7"],"location":"callback: schedule_callback post_process_code","message":"A valid callback whose API call returns false or fails is directed to no_callback. The source defines no_callback only when the second offered time is outside the allowed window; for an eligible time it requires calling schedule_callback and closing callback. The workflow invents a failure disposition for an otherwise valid offer.","fix":"Resolve callback scheduling failure from an applicable source rule; do not map it to no_callback without authority."},{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:3","brief-a:4","brief-a:43"],"location":"opening_identity: transitions and max_turn_transition","message":"The always transition and max-turn transition to terminal can preempt the identity dialogue. A customer who asks an AI or scam question before confirming identity must get the specified answer first, followed by the required second identity ask when needed; a turn-limit terminal transition can close without that sequence or a selected source-defined terminal disposition.","fix":"Ensure interruption handling and the required second ask complete before terminal routing; remove unconditional turn-limit termination or give it a compliant resolution path."},{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:32","brief-a:41","brief-a:closing.p2"],"location":"verified_account: transfer_to_agent tool description; restructuring_handoff/general_handoff","message":"The verified_account transfer tool description permits only support transfers. If the customer mentions hardship and requests a new payment plan, rule 32 has priority over rule 41, but the workflow routes to restructuring_handoff or does not make the support queue available at that priority. Also, a transfer following an already recorded promise must close transferred with the transfer reason; the restructuring/general stages provide no explicit preservation or precedence handling.","fix":"Make hardship handling highest priority even when restructuring is requested, and ensure every transfer stage preserves recorded promises and closes with the transfer's reason."},{"severity":"error","source_ids":["brief-a:11","brief-a:12","brief-a:13"],"location":"opening_identity: verify_identity tool config and post_process_code","message":"The tool is configured with maxRetries 0 and connect_retries 0. The source API explicitly says a 500 verification failure may be repeated; the workflow post-processor instead asks for the answer again without directing a retry of the tool call. This can strand identity verification or prompt the customer to repeat valid data without rechecking it. The swapped-date hint path also does not establish that the date answer is resent in YYYY-MM-DD after the month is spoken as a word.","fix":"On a service failure repeat the verify_identity call with the same field and answer; on day_month_swapped, reparse the customer's corrected spoken date and call again without incrementing wrong-answer count."},{"severity":"warning","source_ids":["brief-a:closing.p1","brief-a:brief-a-freya-bank-early.p2"],"location":"workflow source coverage","message":"The workflow leaves source-required branches as prompt-only instructions with no explicit state predicates for paid, dispute, repeated refusal, deceased/wrong-number, date and amount corrections, and terminal precedence. Plausible paths depend on model interpretation, but the artifacts do not establish those branches or guarantee exactly one valid close_call across interruptions.","fix":"Represent the terminal conditions and precedence as explicit states/guards, especially paid versus dispute, correction revalidation, repeated refusal, and mandatory farewell-before-close."}],"counterexamples":[{"source_ids":["brief-a:32","brief-a:41"],"scenario":"After verification, customer says they lost their job and asks for lower instalments; they decline support, then ask for a restructuring transfer.","expected_output":"Say one short sentence of sympathy, make no persuasion attempt, offer support. If they decline, close no_promise/hardship; rule 32 takes precedence over restructuring (rule 41)."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:6","brief-a:7"],"scenario":"A relative offers an eligible callback today, but schedule_callback returns ok:false.","expected_output":"Do not claim it was scheduled or substitute no_callback based on the source's outside-window rule. The source leaves tool failure disposition unspecified; flag for policy resolution."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:11","brief-a:12","brief-a:13"],"scenario":"DOB is given as numeric 04/05/1990; verification returns day_month_swapped; customer corrects to 'May fourth, 1990'; the next verification call returns 500.","expected_output":"Interpret the numeric input day/month/year, ask for month as a word on the hint, retry without counting the swap as wrong, and retry the failed service call as permitted by API. Do not claim verification or failure until actual result."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:18","brief-a:19","brief-a:20","brief-a:22","brief-a:23","brief-a:29","brief-a:35"],"scenario":"On Friday, with late-band deadline computed from call-variable now and the supplied holidays, customer says 'next Friday'; during read-back they changes amount below floor and date after deadline.","expected_output":"Interpret next Friday as following calendar week, check against computed deadline, reject the below-floor amount and after-deadline date, offer only allowed values, reread and reconfirm before create_promise; never use real clock."},{"source_ids":["brief-a:24","brief-a:25","brief-a:26","brief-a:27","brief-a:30","brief-a:31","brief-a:38"],"scenario":"Credit-card full past-due amount is declined; customer then proposes below minimum, refuses the floor, then says no to paying today without date or amount.","expected_output":"Ask for full amount first; offer floor once and state rest remains overdue. Treat refusal as a flat refusal under attempt rules, do not solicit a customer-selected amount or repeat an already refused offer; if a promise is recorded, say the required text-message sentence."}]}
